channel.title: $GFOF Corrections Log
channel.description: Every promise the Galactic Federation of Finance has made publicly — what we committed to, what we kept, what we missed, and what we learned. Entries are appended, never deleted.

item.title: #014 · COMMITMENT — Formal audit engagement initiated at bond completion
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: On 2026-05-19, in the bond-trigger commitment thread published from @GFOF_Offcial (cross-posted to Telegram and to Week 07 of the Federation Research Log), the Federation publicly committed to initiating formal audit engagement immediately upon $73K bond completion. The engagement covers any deployed contract code before activation. The commitment is to the engagement process, not to a finished audit by any specific date or by any specific firm. Audit firms have been researched but will not be named publicly until findings are delivered and published — avoiding the common DeFi pattern of "audited by X" claims made before findings exist. What activates at trigger: engagement process begins immediately; bug bounty scope expands to cover all newly-deployed contracts; when findings deliver, they are published in full including findings inconvenient to the project. What is NOT committed: a finished audit by date X, a named firm, an audit cost, or an audit duration — these are outside the team's unilateral control. Status: standing commitment, ON TRACK pending bond. Appended, never edited retroactively.

item.title: #013 · COMMITMENT — Voluntary supply lock: 30M added in 4th Streamflow contract; tokenomics figure updated to 77/10/13
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: On 2026-05-19, an additional 30,000,000 $GFOF from team-controlled treasury were committed to a new Streamflow lock contract — a 4th immutable contract supplementing the existing 3. Recipient: project treasury wallet. Full cliff release 2028-05-31. Contract: Fi2bBhWjU8j5W9orTfzrQi3QyTGgY8RFkmzKogeHnJ5x. New locked total: 130M $GFOF (13% of total supply) across 4 Streamflow contracts, verifiable on-chain. Tokenomics figure update: the previous public breakdown of 80% community/liquidity, 10% rewards/reserve, 10% dev rounded team-held treasury tokens into the community/liquidity bucket; the new lock moves 30M of those team-held tokens explicitly into the locked-dev column. Site copy updated this deploy to reflect on-chain reality: 77% community/liquidity, 10% rewards/reserve, 13% dev locked. The original 10%-dev / 100M / 3-contract claim was accurate for the previously-locked portion (Lock 1 30M + Lock 2 30M + Lock 3 40M = 100M); this entry documents the expansion to 130M / 4 contracts and the more precise breakdown going forward. Non-circulation discipline rationale. Standing commitment, active; appended, never edited retroactively.

item.title: #012 · COMMITMENT — Post-quantum posture: research-tracking commitment, no claims
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The Federation formally logs its post-quantum posture as a research-tracking commitment, not a feature or guarantee. Four parts: (1) a cryptographic-dependency inventory mapping which transparency artifacts are hash-durable versus signature-exposed, inaugural inventory published as Research Log Week 06; (2) tracking NIST and Solana-ecosystem developments on the existing research cadence; (3) trigger-based re-evaluation, not dates — triggers are protocol-level PQC shipping on Solana, a credible dated quantum-computer forecast, or NIST finalizing FN-DSA; (4) a standing anti-claim: no quantum-resistance marketing, no quantum-secured badge, no QFS framing. The anti-claim is binding: any quantum-security claim the Federation publishes is by definition a corrections-log event. Trigger status at filing: trigger (a) partially activated 2026-04-27 (Anza/Firedancer Falcon convergence + prototypes) but did not fully fire (not protocol-level adoption, per Jump Crypto's own write-up); the documented re-assessment obligation was met in Week 06; no Federation action obligated. Standing commitment, active, reviewed on research cadence, appended never edited.

item.title: #H010 · KEPT — Cross-post canonical commitment revised; Medium machine-canonical confirmed not externally settable (third revision of the cross-post commitment)
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: Third revision of the cross-post commitment (#008 to #H008 to #H010), stated plainly as a signal rather than framed as routine refinement. The machine-readable Medium canonical was tested two ways: retroactively on Week 03/04 (per #H009) and at first-publish on Week 06 (the #H009 forward-fix hypothesis). Both failed — Medium's published canonical meta tag self-references the Medium URL in both cases. Confirmed finding: Medium does not honor a custom external-domain canonical regardless of when set. The #H009 forward-fix is marked invalidated — a reasonable hypothesis that testing disproved. Revised commitment: Paragraph remains canonical and published first; the Medium cross-post carries human-readable canonical pointers (a header reference and a foot Cross-posting section with the full clickable Paragraph URL); the machine-readable tag limitation is documented once here, not re-footnoted per post. Honest note on the Week 06 Medium post specifically: the bottom Cross-posting section is present with a working clickable Paragraph link (the functioning mitigation); the header Canonical line is present but plain text not a link (weak). #008, #H008, #H009 unchanged and remain in full.

item.title: #H009 · KEPT — Research Log Week 03/04 catch-up published (CLARITY Act); cadence resolved
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: RESOLUTION appended 2026-05-19. The combined Week 03/04 catch-up post, "The CLARITY Act and the Federation's Posture," is published. #H009 moves DELAYED to KEPT. Week 05 window (2026-05-13 through 2026-05-20) was met. Canonical on Paragraph: paragraph.com/@gfofofficial/federation-research-log-week-0304. Cross-posted to Medium: medium.com/@gfofofficial/federation-research-log-week-03-04. Honest note on #H008 compliance: the Medium cross-post points to the Paragraph canonical in two human-readable places (a "Canonical: Paragraph" link under the title, and a full Cross-posting section with the complete Paragraph URL), but Medium's machine-readable canonical meta tag continues to self-reference the Medium URL. This is a known Medium platform limitation — a custom canonical set retroactively on an already-published native Medium post is not reliably honored. It was attempted and did not take. This is a platform constraint, not a discipline lapse, recorded rather than hidden. Forward fix: future cross-posts set the Medium canonical at first-publish time, not retroactively. The original DELAYED entry text is preserved in full on the corrections page; this resolution is appended, not overwritten. Cadence resumes weekly per #H005 — Week 06 due 2026-05-27.

item.title: #H009 · DELAYED — Research Log cadence missed for Week 03 and Week 04, resumed Week 05 with combined catch-up post
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The Federation Research Log committed to a weekly cadence under #H005 on launch (2026-04-22). Week 01 (2026-04-22) and Week 02 (2026-04-29) shipped on time. Week 03 (due 2026-05-06) and Week 04 (due 2026-05-13) did not ship. Two scheduled posts were missed. Federation development bandwidth during the May 5–14 window was concentrated on shipping infrastructure work — SEO foundation, performance pass, FAQ page, research index, custom 404, FCC advance briefing, Dossier integration as the Federation's first Intelligence operation, and supporting corrections entries. The Research Log was deprioritized. The discipline says missed posts get logged whether the reason was reasonable or not. Resolution path: a combined Week 03/04 catch-up post ships in Week 05 (window: 2026-05-13 through 2026-05-20) covering the CLARITY Act draft released May 12 and the Federation's posture under its provisions. Cadence going forward: weekly resumes. Week 06 due 2026-05-27. Status transitions from DELAYED to KEPT once the catch-up post is published; transitions to MISSED if Week 05 itself slips beyond 2026-05-20. A weekly publication that goes silent for two weeks without acknowledgment is the failure mode the Federation built the corrections log to prevent. This entry is that discipline being applied to itself.

item.title: #011 · COMMITMENT — Intelligence arm revenue contribution: Dossier feeds Federation liquidity
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The Galactic Federation operates products. The first operational product is Dossier — the Federation's intelligence arm, a smart-money convergence detector for Solana, live at dossiertrack.co. Dossier has independent branding and pricing, but it operates inside the Federation's structural commitments. One of those commitments is that revenue flows back. Dossier has committed publicly (Dossier Corrections #006) to deploying a staged percentage of its net revenue directly into $GFOF/SOL liquidity on Raydium, quarterly, with on-chain transaction proof. Phase 1 (beta through ~Aug 2026): no revenue, no contribution. Phase 2 (paid launch through first $5K MRR): 25% of net revenue to Raydium LP, quarterly. Phase 3 ($5K MRR sustained two consecutive quarters): 50% of net revenue, same cadence. Dossier Treasury Wallet: G1MLNThNPE8hcZQfNTcjZGEDaSx1otutcNScLazBc92Y, public on Solscan. Mechanism: Stripe payouts to dedicated treasury wallet, quarterly conversion, addition to $GFOF/SOL Raydium LP. LP receipt permanently held by Dossier Treasury. Quarterly injection details appended to Dossier Corrections #006 with transaction signatures verifiable on Solscan. This is not a marketing promise. It is a structural commitment from a Federation operation back into Federation liquidity. The Galactic Federation does not extract value from its operations — its operations feed it. Dossier is the first such operation. Future Federation operations will follow the same pattern, with each commitment logged here and on the operation's own corrections log. Status: Phase 1, pre-revenue, beta. First obligated contribution begins on Dossier paid launch.

item.title: #H008 · KEPT — Commitment #008 corrected (Mirror.xyz migrated into Paragraph and no longer exists as a separate platform)
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: Commitment #008 was published earlier today with the text "Research Log cross-posted to Medium and Mirror within 24 hours of Paragraph publication." That text is not executable: Mirror.xyz consolidated into Paragraph in September 2025 and the migration completed in late 2025. Mirror is no longer a separate publishing surface. Commitment #008 is hereby revised to read "Research Log cross-posted to Medium within 24 hours of Paragraph publication." Paragraph remains the canonical surface; Medium remains the secondary surface; Mirror is removed because it no longer exists as a distinct platform. The correction is filed pre-execution — before the first scheduled cross-post (Week 03, due 2026-05-06) — so the first test of #008 runs against corrected text. The original text of #008 is preserved in this correction entry as the historical record of what was committed before the fix. A corrections log that cannot correct itself in public has no integrity; this entry is the discipline being applied to the discipline itself.

item.title: #H007 · KEPT — @GFOF_Offcial cadence rule clarified to permit engagement activity alongside originated posts
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The Federation has operated under an implicit @GFOF_Offcial posting rule of 2-4 measured originated posts per week, but the rule was ambiguous about engagement activity. This revision clarifies the rule rather than loosens it: the 2-4 originated posts per week discipline stands unchanged. Alongside it, three additional bounded practices are now binding commitments on this page — Research Log cross-posting to Medium within 24h (#008, revised by #H008), monthly Federation Office Hours in Telegram (#009), and daily reply engagement within bounded discipline (#010). Off-limits remain: volume bots, paid KOL (paused under #007), hype framing, urgency framing around bond, simulated activity, daily originated posts, raid coordination. The discipline distinguishing the Federation from category norms is preserved.

item.title: #010 · COMMITMENT — Daily reply engagement on @GFOF_Offcial within bounded discipline
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: Alongside the unchanged 2-4 originated posts per week rule, the Federation now engages substantively with the broader DeFi conversation on a daily cadence: replies to substantive DeFi research threads, retweets-with-comment of relevant analytical work, and replies to mentions of the Federation account. Engagement window is bounded to ~5-15 minutes per day, substantive threads only. No promotional commentary, no shilling. Casual Federation voice acceptable; Voss voice reserved for substantive declarations and Office Hours opening/closing. Tracked weekly: KEPT if engagement occurs at least 5 of 7 days; MISSED if absent 3+ consecutive days without stated reason.

item.title: #009 · COMMITMENT — Federation Office Hours held monthly in Telegram
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The Federation will hold Office Hours monthly in the Telegram community (t.me/GFOF_SOL) — third Wednesday of each month at 2 PM EST / 7 PM UTC, 30-45 minutes maximum. Pre-announced 7 days prior on @GFOF_Offcial; pinned in Telegram 24 hours prior; archived within 48 hours of completion. Substantive Q&A only — not a hype event, not a price discussion, not a roadmap announcement venue. Voss-voiced opening and closing; founder voice for Q&A. Off-topic questions (price predictions, financial advice, unrelated crypto) declined politely. Inaugural session: Wednesday, May 21, 2026.

item.title: #008 · COMMITMENT — Research Log cross-posted to Medium within 24 hours of Paragraph publication (revised by #H008)
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: Beginning with Week 03 (due 2026-05-06), each weekly Federation Research Log issue is cross-posted to Medium within 24 hours of Paragraph publication, with a clearly stated canonical link back to the Paragraph original. The cross-post is not new writing — it is the same essay, distributed to an additional surface. Paragraph remains the source of record. Tracked weekly: KEPT if the cross-post publishes within 24 hours; DELAYED if delayed beyond 48 hours; MISSED if a week is skipped without a public reason recorded. Originally published as "Medium and Mirror"; revised by #H008 on 2026-05-05 because Mirror.xyz consolidated into Paragraph in late 2025 and no longer exists as a separate platform.

item.title: #H006 · KEPT — Federation Research Log Week 02 published on schedule
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: On 2026-04-29 the Federation Research Log published Week 02: "The indexer gap — what pre-bond projects can't see and what to do about it." The essay covers the structural reasons projects below a certain scale are invisible to standard indexing tools (Dune decoded tables, Bubblemaps, DefiLlama) and argues that the surfaces a project controls become the canonical source of trust during this period. First scheduled cadence test under #H005 — kept on time. Week 03 is due 2026-05-06.

item.title: #H005 · KEPT — Federation Research Log launched on Paragraph — Week 01 published
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: On 2026-04-22 the Federation Research Log launched on Paragraph with Week 01: "Why intent-based DeFi changes everything" — an analysis of the imperative/declarative split in DeFi UX, the solver-competition model (CoW Protocol, UniswapX, Anoma), and why the Federation is studying intent-based architecture for Solana. The post explicitly states the Federation is not announcing an intent-based product, only documenting that it is studying the direction. Five publication terms committed to on the corrections log: weekly cadence, no paywalls, no price predictions, no roadmap announcements, and analytical-not-promotional. Future entries will record each weekly publication (or acknowledge its absence), and the first break of any of the five terms becomes its own correction entry.

item.title: #H004 · KEPT — Home page revised to align with research-first discipline
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The v17 deploy revised the home page to remove marketing patterns that contradicted the disciplined posture established across the liquidation spec, treasury page, corrections log, security policy, and the hardened v16 server-side chatbot prompt. Federation Points System reframed to remove specific point values and token-allocation promises. Staking section given a "DESIGN DIRECTION · NOT YET SPEC'D" banner; specific multipliers and "20% APY base" projections reframed as draft proposals. Founding Member NFT perks rewritten as "Proposed" with cross-links to forthcoming specs; FOMO language removed. Tokenomics pie, roadmap Phase 02 and 03, and community card blurbs rewritten. Both client-side chatbot widgets (home + app) rerouted to /api/chat so the disciplined server-side prompt is the single source of truth. Meta and structured data updated to the research-first voice. Machine-readable JSON-LD added to corrections (Dataset) and security (TechArticle).

item.title: #007 · COMMITMENT — No paid promotional spend resumes without a written, published liquidity trigger
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The federation has paused paid KOL campaigns and paid promotional spend pending a return of macro liquidity. Before paid spend resumes, the federation commits to publishing a written set of market signals (the "trigger") that must be met. Loosening the trigger requires a 14-day waiting period with the amendment logged here. Tightening is unconstrained. First-draft framework: a 3-of-4 threshold across TOTAL3 reclaim, SOL price sustain, Solana DEX volume, and Pump.fun/Moonshot graduate trend. Published as a draft; will be marked v1.0 after one round of refinement, at which point it becomes binding under the amendment rules.

item.title: #H003 · KEPT — Publish a substantive revision to the liquidation spec within one week of v0.1
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: When v0.1 of the liquidation spec was published on 2026-04-20, the federation committed to substantive iteration rather than the more common pattern of publishing a design doc once and never revisiting it. Resolution: Kept. v0.2 published 2026-04-21, adding Section 7 on non-standard collateral types — connecting the existing mechanism to the broader DeFi capital-efficiency conversation. No mechanism changes from v0.1; framing addition only. Full diff in the revision log on the spec page.

item.title: #006 · COMMITMENT — Public liquidation design spec before any lending code ships
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: Before writing any smart contract code for the lending protocol, the federation publishes a public design spec for borrower-protective liquidation. The spec is open to public criticism, and its revisions will be tracked here. Status: v0.2 of the spec is live at /liquidation-spec (v0.1 published 2026-04-20, v0.2 published 2026-04-21 adding Section 7 on non-standard collateral types). Revisions are versioned. Each revision's diff is documented in the spec's own revision log and as a corrections entry.

item.title: #H002 · KEPT — Ship a live on-chain transparency page before asking for trust on the lending protocol
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The federation publicly committed that before any lending-product trust ask, we would ship a live transparency page that reads directly from Solana. Resolution: Kept. /treasury shipped v1 on 2026-04-19, extended on 2026-04-20 with the Unlock Early-Warning System. All numbers are read from the chain in the visitor's browser — not served from our server.

item.title: #005 · COMMITMENT — Monthly Federation Intelligence Report
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: A substantive monthly publication — DeFi trend analysis, protocol teardowns, security issues in our space. Free. No paywall. Published as both a PDF and a pinned X thread. Status: First issue in preparation, target May 2026. If a scheduled issue ships more than 7 days late, it will be marked DELAYED with the reason. If we skip a month entirely, it will be marked MISSED.

item.title: #002 · COMMITMENT — Unlocked Federation tokens do not go to the open market
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: When the first Streamflow unlock event occurs, the released tokens will not be sold into the market. They will either be re-locked, rotated into operational treasury (visible on-chain), or used per a specific, pre-announced purpose. This will be verifiable on-chain both before and after the event. Status: Commitment standing. Will be tested at the next unlock — see countdown on /treasury.

item.title: #H001 · KEPT — Launch without paid KOLs, without an influencer round, without promises we couldn't keep
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: Before launch, the federation committed to a quiet start: no paid KOL campaigns, no influencer allocations, no roadmap items promised without a clear path to delivery. Resolution: Kept. Launch was organic. No KOL checks have been cut. Roadmap items are documented on the corrections page as specific commitments with status, not as generic future promises.

item.title: #001 · COMMITMENT — 10% of supply locked on Streamflow across 3 immutable contracts
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: Before launch, the federation committed to locking 10% of total supply across 3 separate Streamflow contracts. The lock contracts are on-chain and immutable. This promise is verifiable in real time on the treasury page. Status: Kept from day one. The three contracts are live. Balances are readable by anyone from Solana RPC.

item.title: #003 · COMMITMENT — Bond at $73K MC triggers Raydium migration
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: Per Moonshot's standard launchpad mechanics, when $GFOF reaches $73K market cap, the token migrates to Raydium. Mint and freeze authorities are revoked automatically as part of the migration. Status: In flight. This is a mechanical trigger, not a team-controlled event — it happens when the market cap is reached. If the bond is not reached and the project winds down, this will be documented here as a cancelled commitment, not silently forgotten.

item.title: #004 · COMMITMENT — Realms DAO governance post-bond
item.dc:creator: Galactic Federation of Finance
item.description: The federation has committed to launching on-chain governance via the Realms platform within 60 days of reaching the bond. Holders will have real voting weight on treasury allocation, staking parameters, and protocol direction. Status: Prerequisite (bond) is still in flight. Advisory polls are being run in Telegram before the formal DAO launches so there's a record of honored community decisions from before vote weight kicks in.
